tests.method: Inspect composition manifest and execute all declared frontend smoke tests.
Compare generated support page with evidence records; inject an unsupported target.
Inspect work grants and exercise a denied raw-device request.
Combine healthy, denied, absent and stalled fake targets and compare the retained observations and reasons across all frontends.
Create a command/schema conflict and confirm a defect is reported rather than inferred away.
Inspect acceptance schema and reject a digest-mismatched record.
Run the structural validator and duplicate-ID/invalid-frontmatter tests.
Regenerate twice and compare exact bytes; check stale-index failure.
Move a fixture using an alias and round-trip an unknown extension.
Validator rejects a requirement lacking a test reference.
Invalidate a changed dependency fixture and verify qualification is withheld.
Round-trip boundary and non-power-of-two-sector examples.
Static dependency scan plus fake-provider composition test.
Replay one fixture through CLI, TUI action simulation and GUI action simulation.
Stress a large sparse image and measure bounded control-message size.
Change a catalog and verify stale generated reference detection.
Path audit with reserved Windows names, case collisions and traversal fixtures.
Compile ABI examples with independent C and C++ clients.
Inspect PE imports and run a clean target VM; do not count successful compilation alone.
Cross-run large-address, byte-order and alignment vectors in modern and constrained probes; unsupported values must fail without truncation.
Launch fixture composition from a read-only directory and verify no adjacent writes.
Alter a current-directory config and environment variable before apply; verify refusal or no effect.
Validate fake manifests with unknown components, dependency cycles, multiple GUI adapters and missing required modules; inspect actual imports before any launch claim.
Compare build and staged inventories; replace one provider after plan review and require rejection.
Trace fake startup with absent providers, corrupt optional settings and offline networking; help/build/command discovery must remain available.
Reconnect and cross-boot fake transcripts with host mismatch, unknown required features and missing remote target; require explicit refusal.
Evaluate conflict and machine-output fixtures.
Run owned/inherited/pipe/absent-handle fixtures plus native launch spike.
Trace fake-provider calls across all invocation cases.
Inject a registry entry without a handler and confirm it is not advertised as executable.
Reject ambiguous/overflowing input and verify exact integer round trips.
Inspect handler routing using a recording fake provider.

Run shared equivalence groups and native metamorphic permutations, including command-specific options before the domain and after operands; preserve literal-tail data and reject misplaced/inapplicable options.

Inject late conflicting/unknown flags, missing values, option-looking filenames and command-looking values; recording fake handlers, output-open hooks and frontend hooks observe no dispatch or initialization.
Compare help at all permitted positions, incomplete domains, unresolved commands and structured output; malformed input remains diagnosed and literal/consumed help tokens stay data.
Protocol malformed-message suite plus maximum-size cases.
Disconnect after dispatch, reconnect and assert no duplicate effect or fabricated cancellation.
Parity tests compare stale-revision, refused and successful action traces.
Accessibility inspection and native screen-reader qualification.
Remove selected fake target and insert another at the same index.
Replay action eligibility across all modes and inspect startup effects.
Install/remove a fixture adapter, preserve foreign entries, and trace portable execution for zero integration writes.
Change drive letter, replace media and disconnect a remote host after selection; no action may follow a stale locator or switch to local storage.
Qualify native/VT/DOS/serial backends under narrow, monochrome, redirected, absent-mouse and interrupted-exit fixtures; no runtime result is claimed by the schema fixture.
Exercise control characters, multiline paste, stale selection, completion/history and resize during review; verify no implicit dispatch or loss of critical context.
Compare the fake inventory/inspect/propose/review/simulate journey with CLI/TUI/GUI, including ambiguous aliases, multiline paste and disconnected selection.
Exercise disabled and session-only history, read-only payload roots, secret-bearing inputs and transient prompts; closing the shell must not fabricate operation completion.
Compare rich, linear and captured fake transcripts for unknown totals, stale/late events, slow consumers, cancellation and failed verification; accepted submission cannot appear as completed success.
Reenumeration, duplicate-GUID and absent-serial negative tests.
Inject a layout change between plan and apply and between two steps.
Supply disagreeing map providers and assert a typed refusal.
Use multipath, attached-image, same-device recovery and shared-LUN fixtures; a second path or partition must not be mistaken for independent ownership or backup.
Boundary tests at zero, device end and u64 overflow.
Offer tape/flux/zoned fixtures to a block-only provider and verify refusal.
Cross-filesystem metadata-loss fixture with a digest-bound acknowledgement.
Malformed corpus plus fuzzing and differential parsers.
Create valid but conflicting primary/backup fixtures.
Byte-diff a fixture around modified entries and compare unchanged regions.
Declare an untested mutation and confirm admission is denied.
Replace provider binary or inject arguments and assert refusal.
Threat-model review and sandbox escape/handle-scope tests.
API-availability fake fixtures and real XP import/launch qualification.
Reject unsupported BitLocker/Storage Spaces/system-volume scenarios.
Reject an executable assessment with one unknown/failed check; preserve denied and stale fake targets alongside successful observations.
Compare CLI/TUI/GUI capability explanations and reject a provider replacement after review.
Exercise changing-source, expired snapshot, missing writer and multi-volume mismatch fixtures and verify downgraded or refused claims.
Trace bare launch and acquisition planning; no snapshot, self-test or destination overwrite occurs without the selected task and scope.
Present known format with an unknown critical feature, a tape target and a consumer-incompatible format request; refuse the affected action without hiding inspection.
Adversarial strings and prompt-injection fixtures across parsers/context ingestion.
Inspect imports/initializers and substitution attacks before elevation.
Negative command and policy tests.
Replay, endpoint spoofing, swapped-binary and stale-plan adversarial tests.
Mutate one plan field after approval and require denial.
Kill client during a fake irreversible stage and inspect durable operation state.
Recording-provider test asserts no writes; cycle fixture verifies diagnostic.
Alter each bound input and confirm apply refuses.
Inspect reports for simulation type and absence of unsupported assurance claims.
Model formatting the executable volume, same-device backup, full journal space and volatile recovery state; refuse destructive dependency loss.
Review overlapping-move fixture and require backup/recovery classification.
Decision gate DE-DEC-004 blocks physical-write work.
Crash-at-every-transition model and target-swap tests.
Fake provider reports success while resulting bytes are wrong.
Reconnect a changed target under a cached inventory entry.
Inject read errors and compare counters and acquisition map.
Simulate late completion and a worker that never confirms cancellation; verify no replacement writer or false cancelled/success result.
Inject stalled/crashed providers, huge input, full destination and slow event consumers; measure limits and verify successful unrelated observations remain usable.
Reject incomplete profiles and inspect exact release manifests.
Compare schema/command IDs and run machine-specific launch tests.
Qualification matrix has no untested entries marked supported.
Cross-run canonical binary vectors and boundary cases.
Check DE-DEC-006 and provider admission manifest.
Inspect planned profile catalog and negative media-role tests.
Shared-LUN fixture refuses absent cluster authority.
Inspect manifests and run a clean-system one-file qualification.
Hash staged, extracted and installed trees and compare.
Update/uninstall during a fake active operation and require defer/refusal.
Reject cyclic H/D/S and recursive-hash fixtures; verify payload equality, inactive embedded resources and independent damaged-D recovery before Setup release.
Integration boundary test and byte-equality verification.
Exercise occupied-root, scope and unsupported-runtime refusals.
DE-DEC-001 acceptance and license-closure review.
Reproduce unsigned payload and independently verify release signatures where supported.
Trace portable/user/machine fixture plans, foreign files, external shortcuts and opt-in PATH changes; reject effects outside the selected scope.
Repair a console-only installation without adding GUI/drivers; refuse or defer removal of an unreachable generation required for recovery.
Exercise missing offline source, pre-existing external tool and changed provider lock; no implicit network access, ownership takeover or storage execution.
Revoke a fake provider during unresolved work and verify new-use refusal plus retained recovery material.
Attempt USK repair of MSI-owned payload, concurrent owner updates and channel migration; reject competing writes and preserve retained generations.
Check offline/silent/versioned Store fixture inputs, incompatible driver/MSIX selection, immutable payload equality and missing channel evidence.
Inspect every exported record for planned/NOT_RUN/false authorization.
Review grant schema and deny prohibited command/path/hardware operations.
Change source spec and require knowledge freshness invalidation.
Mutate a selected file and require context verification failure.
Validate unrun-test and uncommitted-patch examples.
Build an intentionally undersized pack and expect a typed failure.
Inspect generated root adapters and run link checks.
Conflict, traversal and symlink tests against bootstrap.
Editorial review against the documentation map.
Alter command registry and verify docs generation/check detects drift.
Inspect reports for explicit scope and non-capabilities.
Review workflow permissions and denied-path tests.
Modify a shared primitive/provider lock and inspect impact selection.
Review acceptance examples and reject missing reviewer/source digest.
Validate a handoff/PR checklist and a deliberately incomplete record.
Inspect code paths and exercise all commands against fixture directories.
Repeat generation and compare, then corrupt one input.
Negative test matrix across YAML, JSON Schema, links and work DAG.
Before release, test empty-but-valid, missing, extra, duplicate/case-colliding, traversal and changed-byte archives against the staging contract.
Review a release record with a missing download check or runtime evidence; no publication/runtime success may be inferred from checksum equality.
Reject unadmitted plugins, unknown critical features and language-private ABI types; compare typed frontend/provider conformance transcripts.
Inspect work dependency/gate graph.
Validate the work catalog and export projection.
Decision-gate test with unrelated read-only work remaining eligible.
Inspect decision catalog and migration entries.
Inspect source registry and integration gates.
Duplicate USB serials, cloned GUIDs, inaccessible volume, removed device, stale ordinal, sleeping media, enormous provider response and cancellation mid-enumeration.
EBR cycle, array multiplication overflow, GPT valid-but-disagreeing copies, truncated image, invalid UTF-16 name, overlapping entries and hot-removal.
Destination equals source through alias, full destination, thin-provisioning exhaustion, disconnected device, corrupt map, resumed different disk, read substitution and destination file preexistence.
Crash before/after each metadata write/flush, altered backup, shortened device, overlapping entry arrays, wrong sector size and unrelated-byte changes.
Active page-file volume, stale partition ID, hidden metadata in a gap, delete-vs-erase confusion, duplicate GUID, interrupted table write and follow-up format without approval.
Nonadjacent free space, capacity race, filesystem maximum, encryption layer, grow-provider success with unchanged filesystem and failure after boundary growth.
Immovable metadata, unsupported filesystem, XP without qualifying provider, hibernation, failed relocation, stale minimum size and power loss before filesystem commit.

Overlap both directions, power loss at every chunk, media error, changed device, corrupt checkpoint, boot reference mismatch, insufficient independent recovery storage and canceled irreversible stage.
Case-fold name collisions, unsupported resource forks/ADS, lost hardlinks, changed source, ACL translation ambiguity, timestamp precision loss and encrypted per-file data.
USB order change, BitLocker protector mismatch, invalid BCD, missing NVMe driver, inaccessible recovery medium, power interruption and normal boot returning before operation completion.
No SMART over bridge, forged serial, media deterioration, accidental self-test, secret leakage, repaired original mislabeled forensic and incomplete acquisition hashes.
Wrong namespace, vendor mismatch, power loss, fake sanitize success, blocked secure state, shared-array collateral effects and ordinary format mislabeled secure erase.
Image fixtures cover stale container, active consumer, unsupported allocation/features, source/recovery alias, provider substitution and out-of-footprint changes.
Exercise quick/full/discard distinctions, false formatter success, interrupted initialization and absent consumer tests; verify truthful results.
